name: establishing-a-formation-baseline
description: Use to compile admitted doctrine and an exact customer office request into a source-bound curriculum revision and immutable formation baseline with disclosed omissions and predecessor relations.
preconditions: every doctrine source has a stable identity and digest
customer overlays have explicit use and egress terms
postconditions: the curriculum covers every requested competency or the request is refused
omissions and parent revisions are explicit
the baseline exactly reproduces the admitted office snapshot and assessment law
